description: Shopping Curator HTTP adapter reuse. Source inspection supports product search price fields, but authenticated live search, product-detail XHR, and member-bound link creation remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Search Curator products and normalize current/list KRW prices
capabilities.blocker: The existing route is an authenticated Curator search. No current Olive Young session was supplied, and the anonymous direct replay returned 403 text/html; live KRW product values remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Read one Olive Young product through a standalone product-detail XHR
capabilities.blocker: No standalone product-detail XHR schema or independent HTTP replay was observed. The product page route is not counted as an API.

capabilities.title: Traverse product-search pages with verified continuation and termination
capabilities.blocker: The source bundle passes pageNumber and pageSize, but product-search continuation semantics and the terminal page contract have not been verified.

capabilities.title: Create and verify an own-account Curator short link
capabilities.blocker: No live account session was supplied. The known membership/education status response does not identify the current member, so the new commerce surface refuses link creation until an authenticated member identity is read and matched before mutation.

capabilities.title: Read the current official Shopping Curator commission terms
capabilities.note: The official guide currently states 7% direct / 3% indirect for external product links and 3% direct / no indirect credit for Shutter tags. Promotional rates can change; values are documented with a checked date and not embedded in runtime logic.

capabilities.title: Sign in or register a customer account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This task concerns product price collection and the Curator integration; customer account signup/login, consent, and terms acceptance were not requested. Authenticated Curator API use still requires a scoped session supplied by the owner.

capabilities.title: Change a member profile, payout data, or settlement request
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested API integration and product price lookup, not account or payout changes.
